draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Member of SEC Student-Athlete Leadership Council and team captain.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 154th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 15th of 22 at LB. He went 176th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Antonio Morrison. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (7th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (14th percentile). College production: 23 tackles in 2020, 22nd of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New England Patriots (practice squad). 76 career games and 16 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 2.8% (92nd percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile), tackles for loss 0 (16th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 off-ball linebacker who played: 35 combined tackles against a median of 66, below the norm.
